tasks.label: KiCad Engine: Audit Installed KiCad App
KiCad Engine: Build Component Database Index
args: $root='${workspaceFolder}'; $outDir=Join-Path $root '05_OUTPUTS/component_database'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $outDir | Out-Null; $files=@(Get-ChildItem -Path (Join-Path $root '08_COMPONENT_DATABASE') -Recurse -File -Include *.md,*.json -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Sort-Object FullName); $stamp=Get-Date -Format o; $md=Join-Path $outDir 'component_database_file_index.md'; $json=Join-Path $outDir 'component_database_file_index.json'; $lines=@('# Component Database File Index','',"Generated: $stamp",'', 'This generated file index is for AI navigation only. It does not prove component, datasheet, pinout, footprint, or lifecycle verification.','', '| File | Size | Last Modified |','| --- | ---: | --- |'); foreach($f in $files){ $componentPath=$f.FullName.Substring($root.Length).TrimStart('\','/'); $lines += "| $componentPath | $($f.Length) | $($f.LastWriteTime.ToString('s')) |" }; Set-Content -LiteralPath $md -Value $lines -Encoding UTF8; $files | Select-Object @{n='relative_path';e={$_.FullName.Substring($root.Length).TrimStart('\','/')}},Length,LastWriteTime | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 4 | Set-Content -LiteralPath $json -Encoding UTF8; Write-Output "Wrote $md and $json for $($files.Count) component database files."

KiCad Engine: Export NOT_FINAL Review Package

args: $path='${workspaceFolder}/.prompts'; if(Get-Command code -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue){ code $path } else { Invoke-Item $path }

tasks.label: KiCad Engine: Generate Setup Report
args: $root='${workspaceFolder}'; $outDir=Join-Path $root '05_OUTPUTS/setup_reports'; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $outDir | Out-Null; $stamp=Get-Date -Format 'yyyyMMdd_HHmmss'; $report=Join-Path $outDir "KICAD_ENGINE_SETUP_REPORT_$stamp.md"; $paths=@('AGENTS.md','START_HERE_FOR_USERS.md','START_HERE_FOR_AI_AGENTS.md','QUICKSTART_WINDOWS.md','QUICKSTART_MACOS.md','QUICKSTART_LINUX.md','.prompts/README.md','.vscode/settings.json','.vscode/tasks.json','.vscode/extensions.json','.vscode/launch.json','03_TOOLS/scripts/kicad_engine_health_check.ps1','03_TOOLS/scripts/kicad_app_audit/audit_kicad_windows.ps1','03_TOOLS/scripts/project_validation/validate_kicad_project.ps1'); $lines=@('# KiCad Engine Setup Report','',"Generated: $(Get-Date -Format o)",'', 'This report is generated locally from the VS Code task system. It does not install tools, configure AI authentication, or modify KiCad design files.','', '## Key Paths',''); foreach($p in $paths){ $full=Join-Path $root $p; $status=if(Test-Path -LiteralPath $full){'FOUND'}else{'MISSING'}; $lines += "- $status: `$p`" }; $lines += @('', '## AI Tool Authentication','', '- Codex, Claude, or another AI coding agent must be installed and logged in by the user.', '- This repo does not store or assume AI credentials.', '', '## Safety', '', '- Run health checks and audits before project edits.', '- Back up KiCad projects before source edits.', '- Keep fabrication-style outputs marked NOT_FINAL until all verification gates pass.'); Set-Content -LiteralPath $report -Value $lines -Encoding UTF8; Write-Output "Wrote $report"
